items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: they’re really into the records more of like Herbie and Wayne Shorter

ctx.x: It’s a hard list. [inaudible] like “My Shining Hour,” “It Could Happen to You,” maybe “One Finger Snap,” you know, tunes like that. Because most of the young kids don’t know the repertoire of the standards or they’re really into the records more of like Herbie and Wayne Shorter, you know sixties, tunes like — what’s that tune — “Black Nile” and tunes like that.
